home.trapSubtitle: Five trap bosses — beat them to truly level up!
home.trap1Symptom: The question is too vague, so the AI can’t tell what you want — of course the answer’s off!
home.trap1Solve: Give the AI clear context, needs, constraints and the output format you expect!
home.trap2Symptom: Blindly copy-pasting others’ prompts and using them without understanding how they work!
home.trap2Solve: Understand the structure and logic first, then adjust to your needs!
home.trap3Symptom: Asking for too much at once — too complex for the AI to nail perfectly in one shot!
home.trap3Solve: Break the problem down, go step by step, and refine gradually!
home.trap4Symptom: Believing everything without thinking, easily misled by wrong info!
home.trap4Solve: Verify sources, cross-check, and keep your skepticism and judgment!
home.trap5Symptom: Copying content without understanding it, so you learn nothing!
home.trap5Solve: Understand first, then output it — make it your own knowledge!

search.heading: Semantic Search
search.intro: Ask in plain language and AI finds the most relevant content across chapters, dungeons, blogs, and forums.
search.placeholder: e.g. How to learn React Hooks from scratch, what is an AI Agent, how to do SEO...
search.noResultsDesc: Try different keywords, or a more specific / shorter question. (If just deployed, the content index may still be building.)
search.example1: How do I learn React Hooks from scratch?
search.example2: Next.js or Nuxt, which is better for SEO?
search.example3: What is an AI Agent and how do I build one?
search.example4: What are TypeScript generics good for?
search.example5: What should I learn first to take on freelance work?
search.suggestFooterMain: Semantic search beats plain keywords: you can ask questions (“how...” “why...”), use synonyms, and find answers across chapters.
search.suggestFooterImpl: Implementation: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small + pgvector cosine similarity, cross-type ranking.
